children.text: These clips function as a way to build up hype for the show itself. The clips itself show an emotionally charged moment on this Reality TV show, but to an outside viewer who hasn't seen the show won't know the context behind why the girls are arguing. It engages viewers by "picking a side," and entices outsiders to watch Love island to understand why people are choosing a side. Functioning as an ad for Love island.
The virality of the short clips that are chosen aid companies like Peacock to function as an ad for their TV Shows or movies.
These clips are an example of how art can't escape it's capitalist base, because
AMV truly is the conception of edits as we know it to be today.
A popular song would be added over clips of an anime series, but it lacked the cool transitions and special effects viewers can see today on Tiktok or Instagram.
